topic: Mauna Kea taller than Everest base to peak
hook: If you measure from the base, Everest loses.
title: The Mountain Taller Than Everest
description:
Measured from its base on the seafloor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea is about 10,200 metres tall, taller than Everest. Only about 4,200 metres of it rises above sea level, so most of the mountain is underwater. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.
